Here is how I automate quote requests in one afternoon.

Here's what the agent does:

✅ Reads every new quote request in Make
✅ Checks it against the price list
✅ Flags the exceptions for a human
✅ Logs everything in one sheet

Build time: one afternoon.
Running cost: about €35 a month.

Result: quotes go out in 20 minutes instead of 2 days.
